target.title: fix(agents): idle-timeout stalled provider response body reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where provider JSON/text/binary success reads could hang indefinitely after headers when the upstream stopped sending body chunks. `fetchWithTimeout` ends once headers return, so a stalled body never failed closed unless the caller passed an idle budget into `readResponseWithLimit`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Keep idle timeout **caller-owned** (no shared 30s default on the plugin-SDK-exported readers). Shared readers now forward optional `chunkTimeoutMs` with labeled `onIdleTimeout` errors. Wired the hang-prone production callers that already have a request timeout — OpenAI-compatible TTS, native PDF providers, and MiniMax VLM — so their body reads reuse that budget after headers.

## User Impact

**Before:** A provider that returned headers and then stalled mid-body could hang TTS, PDF, MiniMax VLM, or any other caller that never passed `chunkTimeoutMs`.

**After:** Callers that pass `chunkTimeoutMs` fail closed on stalled bodies. TTS / PDF / MiniMax VLM reuse their existing request timeout for that idle budget. Omitting `chunkTimeoutMs` keeps prior unbounded-body behavior (no silent global cutoff that shortens longer provider deadlines).

## Evidence

- Changed: `src/agents/provider-http-errors.ts`, `src/agents/provider-http-errors.test.ts`, `src/tts/openai-compatible-speech-provider.ts`, `src/tts/openai-compatible-speech-provider.test.ts`, `src/agents/tools/pdf-native-providers.ts`, `src/agents/minimax-vlm.ts`
- Production caller paths:
  - `createOpenAiCompatibleSpeechProvider` → `readProviderBinaryResponse(..., { chunkTimeoutMs: req.timeoutMs })`
  - native PDF POST helper → `readProviderJsonResponse(..., { chunkTimeoutMs: NATIVE_PDF_PROVIDER_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS })`
  - MiniMax VLM → `readProviderJsonResponse(..., { chunkTimeoutMs: timeoutMs })`

## Real behavior proof

### Behavior or issue addressed

Caller-owned idle timeout rejects stalled provider success bodies; omitting `chunkTimeoutMs` does not invent a shared default.

### Canonical reachability path

Caller → `readProviderJsonResponse` / `readProviderTextResponse` / `readProviderBinaryResponse({ chunkTimeoutMs })` → `readResponseWithLimit({ chunkTimeoutMs, onIdleTimeout })`.

### Real environment tested

Real HTTP transport: local `node:http` on `127.0.0.1` that returns `200` headers plus one chunk then never completes. Branch production readers driven via `fetch`. Node v22.23.1.

### Exact steps or command run after this patch

```bash
# Ephemeral driver (not committed):
node --import tsx /tmp/proof-provider-response-idle-timeout.mts

# Supplemental focused regression:
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/provider-http-errors.test.ts src/tts/openai-compatible-speech-provider.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

### Evidence after fix

```text
node=v22.23.1
repo=/Users/shen/Documents/GitHub/openclaw
idleMs=300 (caller-owned; no shared default)
  ok: stalled JSON read rejected (not hung) — elapsed=320ms
  ok: idle-timeout error surfaced from branch reader — proof.stalled-json: JSON response stalled after 300ms
  ok: terminated within ~idle budget — elapsed=320ms
  ok: stalled TEXT read rejected — proof.stalled-text: text response stalled after 300ms
  ok: TEXT terminated within ~idle budget — elapsed=306ms
  ok: unbounded response.json() still hanging after 2000ms — state=still-hanging
  ok: omitted chunkTimeoutMs still hanging after 2000ms — no shared default
  ok: small completing body parsed — {"id":"ok","name":"small"}

ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS PASSED
```

Supplemental focused regression:

```text
✓ times out when a successful 'JSON' response body stalls after headers
✓ times out when a successful 'text' response body stalls after headers
✓ times out when a successful 'binary' response body stalls after headers
✓ maps configured extra JSON body fields into synthesis requests
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  25 passed (25)
```

### Observed result after fix

Against a real stalled HTTP socket, callers that pass `chunkTimeoutMs: 300` reject in ~306–320ms with `… response stalled after 300ms`. Omitting `chunkTimeoutMs` stays hanging after 2000ms (no shared default). Raw `response.json()` also stays hanging. A completing body still parses.

### What was not tested

Live stall against a real third-party provider endpoint. Remaining `readProvider*` call sites that do not yet pass `chunkTimeoutMs` stay unbounded by design until those owners wire their deadlines.

### Fix classification

bugfix — timeout/hang

## AI Assistance

AI-assisted. Author reviewed the caller-owned idle bound, wired TTS/PDF/MiniMax paths, and the live-socket proof output.
